guard.mockNotice: Prototype: the role check is simulated. Real authentication is added later.
guard.deniedBody: This area is only available to platform super admins.

common.utcNote: All times are shown in UTC.
common.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the decision. This is recorded in the audit log.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.description: All shops on the platform. Filter by status and open a shop to manage it.

orgDetail.actionsActive: Suspending a shop makes its landing page return 404, switches its dashboard to read-only with a banner and stops new bookings. Existing bookings are kept.
orgDetail.actionsSuspended: This shop is suspended. Reactivating restores its landing page, dashboard access and online bookings.
orgDetail.actionsOther: Suspend and reactivate are only available for shops in the Active or Suspended state.
orgDetail.suspendBody: The landing page will return 404 and new bookings will be blocked. Provide a reason for the audit log.
orgDetail.reactivateBody: The landing page and bookings become available again. Provide a reason for the audit log.

reviews.title: Review queue
reviews.description: Shops waiting for approval before they go live.
reviews.approveBody: The shop becomes Active and its landing page goes live.
reviews.rejectBody: The shop returns to Draft and the owner is told why. A reason is required.
reviews.rejected: {name} was rejected and returned to Draft.

reviewDetail.notPendingTitle: This shop is not waiting for review
reviewDetail.notPendingBody: Current status: {status}. Only shops in Pending review can be approved or rejected.
reviewDetail.name: Name
reviewDetail.checklistHint: Advisory only. Tick items as you verify them.

checklist.identity: Shop name and slug are appropriate and not misleading
checklist.contact: Contact details and address look genuine
checklist.content: No prohibited, scam or phishing content
checklist.workshops: At least one workshop has clear pricing and description
checklist.languages: Content is complete for every enabled language

reviewDetail.previewBody: A read-only render of the draft landing page will appear here once the page builder is connected.

reports.title: Report management
reports.description: Reports sent by visitors with "Report this site" on a shop's landing page. Review each one, then resolve it or dismiss it.
reports.resolveBody: Mark the report as handled. Add an optional note for the audit log.
reports.dismissBody: Mark the report as not actionable. Add an optional note for the audit log.
reports.loadError: The reports could not be loaded.
reports.conflict: This report was already handled by someone else. The list was refreshed.
reports.saveError: The report could not be updated. Please try again.

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.description: Platform-wide record of administrative and shop activity.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.intro: Close or open any session of this shop that has not ended. The limits of the shop owner (3 re-schedules, 4 closes) do not apply to you, and your changes are not counted in them.
sessions.closeBody: The shop owner will see this in the history of the session. Please give the reason.
sessions.failed: The session could not be changed.

fees.formula: Each shop has its own rates. Profit of this shop = total income − maintenance fee − service fee.
fees.maintenanceHint: Taken from every booking: a percentage of what the booking paid.
fees.serviceHint: A percentage of the income of the shop.
fees.saved: Fees saved. The Income page of this shop uses the new rates.
fees.saveFailed: The fees could not be saved.

errors.invalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most 2 decimals.
errors.totalTooHigh: The two fees together cannot be more than 100%.
